description: Set ball thermal extra variables. The extra variable can be of any type and is associated with the index i as if stored in an array.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): 'thermal extra 1 3.25' read back via ball.thermal.extra on all six consoles.
